cue.heading: Eleventh Circuit, Younge (2025)
cue.quote: Since Hassan, we have repeatedly reaffirmed that a district court may receive evidence of an unpleaded affirmative defense if the plaintiff was <mark>not “prejudiced”</mark> by the defendant’s failure to plead the defense in its answer.
